top_signals.title: Ransomware attack on Belarusian cloud firm disrupts businesses for days
top_signals.summary: ActiveCloud said hackers had breached its systems and encrypted parts of its cloud infrastructure, leaving customers unable to access key services for several days.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cargojet fleet optimization boosts productivity, fuels record Q3 revenue
top_signals.summary:
Cargojet rode a strong air cargo market and the productivity gains from its fleet consolidation strategy to its highest-ever revenue and operating profit in a third quarter.

The post Cargojet fleet optimization boosts productivity, fuels record Q3 revenue appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
